matched_note.title: UPSC CSE Mains Answer Writing Framework: Structure, Committee Quotes & Data Points

drafted_comment:
The real issue isn't just writing fast; it's about having a pre-built structure so you don't waste time thinking on the page. Toppers don't 'invent' answers during the exam; they use a framework.

1. Use the 4-Anchor Formula: Start with a Constitutional basis or definition, move to 2-3 dimensions with committee names (like 2nd ARC), add a hard data point, and end with a way forward. This keeps you on track.
2. Stop overthinking: If you have the facts and committee quotes ready, the writing flows naturally. 
3. Practice with limits: Train your brain to hit the 150/250 word mark by focusing on high-yield points rather than fluff.
